title: Game Trees: Minimax and Alpha-Beta Pruning
title_zh: 博弈树：Minimax 与 Alpha-Beta 剪枝
desc: Back terminal utilities through alternating MIN and MAX nodes, then see Alpha-Beta skip branches that cannot change the exact minimax decision. Change move order to separate search work from search result.
desc_zh: 通过交替的 MIN 和 MAX 节点回传终局效用值，再观察 Alpha-Beta 如何跳过不可能改变精确 minimax 决策的分支。改变走子顺序，以区分搜索工作量与搜索结果。
featured: Find the first safe prune, then reorder the same tree to change work without changing the answer.
featured_zh: 找到第一次安全剪枝，再重新排列同一棵树，让搜索工作量改变而答案保持不变。
